question: 1. Choose the correct indirect speech of the sentence: He said, “I will do the work.” [DPDC-ME,EEE-25]
options: (a) He said that he will do the work.
(b) He said that he would do the work.
(c) He said that I will be do the work
(d) He said that he would done the work.
answer: (b) He said that he would do the work.
explanation: Direct speech: He said, “I will do the work.” Indirect speech এ “will” -> “Would” হয় (কারণ reporting verb “said” অতীত কালে) এবং subject “I” পরিবর্তিত হয়ে he হয়। He said that he would do the work.

question: 2. I said to her, “You were making me laugh.” Choose the correct one for the change of the narration. [DESCO-SSA-25]
options: (a) I told her that she had making me laugh
(b) I told her that you had been making me laugh
(c) I told her that she was making me laugh
(d) I told her that she had been making me laugh
answer: (d) I told her that she had been making me laugh
explanation: Said to- এর পরিবর্তে told + Inverted comma উঠে গিয়ে that + Reported speech-এর 2nd person Reported verb-এর object অনুযায়ী পরিবর্তিত হয়ে She + Past continuous -> Past perfect continuous tense.

question: 3. Change the narration: The little girl said to her mother, “Did the sun rise in the East?” [MPL- EEE/ME/Chemistry-25]
options: (a) The little girl said to her mother that the sun rose in the East
(b) The little girl asked her mother if the sun rose in the East.
(c) The little girl said to her mother if the sun rises in the East.
(d) The little girl asked her mother if the sun is in the East.
answer: (b) The little girl asked her mother if the sun rose in the East.

question: 4. The indirect form of the sentence “He said, let us go for a walk” is- [BCPCL-MT-25]
answer: He proposed to me that we should go for a walk.
explanation: Imperative sentence এর Narration করার সময় Proposed, suggest ইত্যাদি বসে। যেমন: He said, “Let us go for a walk.” = He proposed that we should go for a walk.

question: 5. Change the sentence into indirect speech. He said, ‘good bye, my friend’- [WZPDCL-EEE-23]
answer: He bade good bye to his friend.

question: 6. “Help! Help! shouted the boy”. Change in indirect speech.[ERLB-MT/ET/CT-22]
options: (a) The boy shouted help, help.
(b) The boy told others help
(c) The boy shouted for help.
(d) The boy told others shouting to help.

question: 7. He said “would that I were rich!” [CPGCBL-ET/MT-22]
options: (a) He wished he had been rich.
(b) He said that he wanted to be rich.
(c) He told everyone that he wanted to be rich.
(d) He begged to be rich.
answer: (a) He wished he had been rich.
explanation: “Would” is used here as a wish. So indirect Sentence would be: He wished that he had been rich. However, if it's a wish about the past, we use ‘had been.’

question: 8. What will be the indirect speech of, He said to us, “Who will be going with us?” [MGMCL: EEE/ME-22]
options: (a) He asked us who would be going with them.
(b) He asked us who will go with them.
(c) He asked us who will go with us.
(d) He wanted to know will we go with them?
answer: (a) He asked us who would be going with them.

question: 9. He said, “I have done the work” change in indirect speech. [TGTDCL-ME-21]
options: (a) He said that he had been doing the work.
(b) He said that he had done the work.
(c) He said that he have done the work.
(d) He said that he has done the work.
answer: (b) He said that he had done the work.

question: 10. He said, “Good bye, my friend”. What will be indirect speech? [DMTCL-ME-19, 20]
options: (a) He said his friend goodbye.
(b) He bade his friend goodbye.
(c) He told his friend goodbye.
(d) He wished his friend goodbye.
explanation: Direct speech-এ ‘good bye’ থাকলে সেটিকে indirect speech-এ রূপান্তর করতে ‘bade’ ব্যবহৃত হয়।

question: 11. Identify the correct indirect form of speech for the following sentence ..... Rapa said ‘I am writing an application now.’ [DESCO-ET-19]
options: (a) Rapa said that she writing an application now.
(b) Rapa said that she was writing an application now.
(c) Rapa said she was writing an application then.
(d) Rapa said that she had been writing an application then.
answer: (c) Rapa said she was writing an application then.
explanation: Direct speech-এ Reported speech টি Present continuous-এ থাকলে Indirect করার সময় Past continuous tense হয় এবং Now এর পরিবর্তে then বসে।
